paper.title: EvoSkill: Automated Skill Discovery for Multi-Agent Systems
paper.central_claim: EvoSkill 通过对执行失败的迭代诊断自动发现并精修可复用的 agent 技能文件夹，以前沿选择仅保留提升验证集的技能，使冻结模型在 OfficeQA/SealQA 上提升，且 SealQA 进化的技能零样本迁移到 BrowseComp，证明技能级优化产生可迁移能力。

provenance.notes: Opus aggregate seat via the configured claude-kimi type fable; no route probing. actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref are null because the subagent runtime exposes no verifiable provider receipt to this worker.

sections_read: Opus: pinned text read before opening seat records (abstract, method, experiments, all tables, appendices; long proof derivations skimmed) ; targeted re-reads for every disputed field

evidence.quote: A Pareto frontier of agent programs governs selection, retaining only skills that improve held-out validation performance while the underlying model remains frozen.

evidence.quote: Ground-truth answers are provided to enable root-cause diagnosis, analogous to examining labeled misclassifications during error analysis in supervised learning
evidence.support_explanation: 信息权限：Proposer 看到执行轨迹、预测答案与金标答案；声称金标不传播到技能内容本身。

evidence.quote: that logs all prior proposals, their outcomes, and score deltas. This serves two purposes: it prevents redundant proposals,
evidence.support_explanation: 反馈历史 H 记录所有提议、结果与分数变化，用于避免重复并改进后续提议。

evidence.quote: via round-robin cycling, ensuring each frontier member is explored before any is revisited.
evidence.support_explanation: 正文：父代按轮转从前沿选取。

evidence.quote: the system selects the highest-scoring program from a maintained frontier
evidence.support_explanation: 附录 D：每轮选前沿中得分最高者作父代——与正文'轮转'不一致（实现细节未对齐）。

evidence.quote: We run EvoSkill on the seal-0 split of SealQA (111 questions) using Claude Code with Opus 4.5 and a 10% training split
evidence.support_explanation: SealQA seal-0 仅 111 题；训练约11题；验证集大小未报告；测试集 = 其余。

evidence.quote: EvoSkill improves accuracy on SealQA from 26.6% to
evidence.support_explanation: SealQA：26.6→38.7（+12.1pp，作者报告）；约相当于十余题的变化，单次运行，且网络检索本身非确定性。

evidence.quote: We evaluate on a stratified sample of 128 examples.
evidence.support_explanation: BrowseComp 迁移：128 题分层样本、仅一条技能、仅 SealQA→BrowseComp 一个方向（43.5→48.8，+5.3pp）。43.5%/48.8% 都不是 128 的整数分数(55.7/62.5 题)，暗示取了多次平均或口径不同，材料未说明。

evidence.quote: This result supports the hypothesis that optimizing at the skill level, rather than at the level of prompts or code, yields more transferable improvements.
evidence.support_explanation: 关于'技能级优于提示/代码级'的主张；实验中没有提示级/代码级优化基线，未直接检验。

evidence.quote: either a new or edited skill file (in skill-only mode) or a rewritten system prompt (in prompt-only mode)
evidence.support_explanation: 实现支持 prompt-only 模式，但正文未报告其结果——最直接的替代优化对照缺位。

evidence.quote: a weighted score below 0.8 flags the example as a failure for targeted skill refinement.
evidence.support_explanation: 训练用多容差加权分(阈值0.8)判定失败；测试用精确匹配；OfficeQA 为确定性模糊匹配器。

evidence.quote: The remaining questions not used for training or frontier selection form the held-out test set.
evidence.support_explanation: SealQA 同样训练/前沿选择/测试三分，测试集不参与进化。

evidence.quote: All agents have read access to the base agent’s repository; only the Skill-Builder has write permissions to the skills directory.
evidence.support_explanation: 权限设计：仅 Skill-Builder 可写技能目录，其他只读。

evidence.quote: Skills accumulate across iterations, progressively expanding the agent’s capabilities while the underlying model remains frozen.
evidence.support_explanation: 技能跨迭代累积；评测的是最终保留的技能库对 held-out 测试的效果。

evidence.quote: The skill-merge configuration achieves the strongest result at 67.9% exact match (+7.3% over baseline), outperforming every individual run.
evidence.support_explanation: The headline (abstract, intro, Fig. 2) is the best of four configurations compared on the test partition. merge-unique is a post-hoc combination of runs.

evidence.quote: we retain the version from the highest-performing run
evidence.support_explanation: The merge's conflict rule ranks runs by performance on an unnamed split. If it is the test split, selection touched test data. Either way it is unreported.

evidence.quote: We evaluate three training set sizes: 5% (12 examples), 10% (24 examples), and 15% (36 examples)
evidence.support_explanation: With validation fixed at 17 and the test equal to 'the remaining questions', the test partitions differ across configurations (217/205/193). The single baseline 60.6 cannot be on all of them, unless it was rerun per split, which is not stated.

evidence.quote: the transferred skill improves accuracy from 43.5% to
evidence.support_explanation: 43.5% and 48.8% of 128 are 55.7 and 62.5 questions, not integers. The effective denominator or averaging is unstated.

gap.author_gap: 技能多为手写；AlphaEvolve/GEPA 等进化方法优化提示/代码这类低层工件，与具体模型和任务紧耦合，难产出可迁移组件。
gap.checked_gap: 被改变的对象是'优化的基因单位'——由提示/代码改为包含指令、触发和脚本的技能文件夹。该单位的 reusability 优势仅为论断，无提示级/代码级优化的并列对照；本质上技能文件夹仍是文本/脚本工件。
gap.lineage/closest_adjacent: Feedback Descent(文本反馈下降，作者称直接构建于其上)、GEPA(反思式提示进化+Pareto选择)、AlphaEvolve、Voyager、Agent Skills 规范、Self-Refine；材料内无这些原文，只有作者概括；同类'失败驱动技能/技能文件修订'(如 SKILL.md 精修类)未对照。
gap.residue: 未量化：既未展示提示级方法在同任务上的迁移失败，也未与之对比。
gap.stakes: 为通用编码 agent 自动获取领域技能，替代手写。
gap.method_response: 失败诊断→技能提案→物化→前沿门控→历史记忆；使用 git 分支做谱系与回溯。
gap.remaining_gap: 技能级是否优于提示级、门控在小验证集上的可靠性、方差、成本、跨模型/harness 迁移均未回答。
unresolved: GEPA/Feedback Descent 原文未固定，无法核对其是否已含技能或类似可迁移单位
附录 D 与正文在父代选择规则上的不一致

rs_pattern.reason: Opus sides with son55. The paper's move frees a conventionally fixed component, the hand-authored skill library, and makes it the evolved unit of a feedback-descent loop around a frozen agent. That is the run convention for agent-harness evolution loops (r11a ReCreate, r03b SICA, r08b Live-SWE: generative_process_redesign, sub null; C15/C23/C24 are representation, diffusion and conditioning tactics and do not apply). sol's C03 is rejected: skills are loaded by trigger or progressive disclosure, not retrieved as reference instances, and no category-holdout or cheaper-conditioner logic is executed. C03 describes how the artifact is consumed, not the paper's operation.

无编辑预算；有 trace/lineage 历史
验证集门控但仅17题且不回放归因样本

matches.reason: 由失败实例驱动的技能新增/修订并以验证集门控保留，是 H11 的主体；缺 H11 核心的缺陷-疏漏区分与有界编辑。

matches.reason: 反馈历史 H 令提案条件于既往结果，类似 H15 的搜索记忆，但存的是原始提案记录而非蒸馏知识。

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: Failures on training items are attributed (with gold answers) to a missing or deficient skill. A create/edit proposal is materialised as a skill folder and retained only if validation improves. The freed component (skill library) is edited by failure attribution.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions/differences: H11's defect-versus-lapse split and edit budget are absent. The validation gate is 17 items on OfficeQA.

pattern_mapping.operation_correspondence: A top-k frontier of programs with a cumulative proposal history (outcomes and score deltas) conditions later proposals, as H15's search-memory layer does.
pattern_mapping.necessary_conditions/differences: The history's value is never measured (S5 unmet). The frontier is a scalar top-k, not complementary (H16 rejected).

assessment.evidence_level_note: Both seats, re-checked. Skills retained by the validation gate improve the disjoint test partition over the same frozen agent without skills, and one skill transfers unmodified to BrowseComp. This is weak retained: the headline is best-of-configs on test (opus:O01), and runs are single. Not improver: the proposer and builder are never changed.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: Validation-gated skill folders evolved from 12–36 OfficeQA training items raise held-out exact match over the no-skill Claude Code baseline in each single run (63.4/65.8/64.5 vs 60.6; post-hoc merge 67.9/68.1). SealQA rises 26.6 → 38.7. One unmodified search skill raises a 128-item BrowseComp sample 43.5 → 48.8. 'Skill-level beats prompt/code-level' and generic transfer are untested.
unresolved: Merge selection split (opus:O02) and per-config test alignment (opus:O03)

G.reason: Both seats 2; re-checked. The hand-authored-skill gap is real. But the premise that prompt- or code-level artifacts 'do not transfer' is asserted, not shown. The loop is Feedback Descent applied to skills, and failure-driven skill-revision neighbours are not compared.

M.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Failure diagnosis with gold labels on train only, create/edit proposals, builder-only write access, a validation-gated frontier and a proposal history form a coherent loop. Not 4: no prediction distinguishes skills from prompts, and the 17-item gate is weak (one item = 5.9 pp).

X.reason: Both seats 3; re-checked. Git branch lineage, frontier tags, eviction, early stop, prompts, scorer and failure threshold are specified. Not 4: parent selection contradicts itself (round-robin in §2.2 vs highest-scoring in App. D), T and batch size are unstated, and the merge rule's split is unnamed (opus:O02).

E.measurement.reason: Opus sides with sol. OfficeQA uses a deterministic fuzzy scorer, and the baseline is cross-checked with the benchmark authors. But the headline 67.9 contradicts Table 1's 68.1 (son55:E014). The BrowseComp percentages imply non-integer counts of 128 (opus:O04), and substring matching and the SealQA LLM judge are unaudited. Run convention: text–table contradictions cap at 2.

E.causality.reason: Opus sides with sol. In skill-only mode the child inherits the parent's system prompt, so base vs evolved on the held-out test isolates the retained skill package. The BrowseComp ± one-skill arm does the same. Not 3: there are no frontier, history or meta-skill ablations and no budget-matched alternative optimizer, and the implemented prompt-only mode is unreported (son55:E022). The skill-versus-prompt claim is untested.

E.holdout.reason: Shared correction 3 → 2. Train, validation and test are disjoint, and the test is never used during evolution. But the headline +7.3 is the best of four configurations compared on that test, and merge-unique was added post hoc (opus:O01). Its overlap rule keeps 'the version from the highest-performing run' on an unnamed split (opus:O02). Test partitions differ across 5/10/15% while one baseline is quoted (opus:O03). The transfer is one skill, one direction, one sample. Selection on the test set is scored here (A2), not in statistics.

E.statistics.reason: Both seats 1 (A2): sample sizes and a non-monotone 10%→15% result are reported. Every configuration is a single run, with no intervals or tests (the authors say so).

E.cost.reason: Opus sides with sol. No iteration count T, proposer/builder/executor tokens, dollars or wall-clock, and no inference overhead of skills vs base. '1.5 epochs' and 'computational cost' are not accounting (precedent r09a: a hardware line alone is not_reported).
search_scope: Opus: complete pinned v1 §1–5 and Appendices A–D (skills, scripts, prompts, scorer, branch environment)
no iteration count, token, dollar, time or call figure anywhere

reason: Complete pinned v1 text incl. Appendices A–D read. In scope (A): failure-driven evolution of non-weight skill folders on a frozen agent, retained by a validation gate and used on disjoint test items. All eight items resolved.

resolutions.reason: See rs_pattern.reason: freeing the hand-fixed skill library inside a feedback-descent loop is the generative_process_redesign move (ReCreate/SICA convention). C03 only describes how skills are consumed.
Follows primary. No sub-card fits (C15/C23/C24 are 3D-representation, diffusion and conditioning tactics).

H11 is kept (both seats). For the population parent, sol's null sub is replaced by H15: the cumulative history of proposals, outcomes and score deltas conditions the proposer, which is H15's search-memory layer (low fit; its value is unmeasured). son55's H16 is rejected. H16 is defined by a complementarity axis, while EvoSkill's 'Pareto frontier' is a scalar top-k replacing the weakest member (son55 itself graded it 'nominal').
Verified: no T, tokens, dollars or time.

The card was not kept. sol's question (no equal-budget prompt-only, history or frontier ablation) is the same as the kept card's RE-3 (and partly RE-2), so it is merged into RE-3. Final unmet: sol's 'partial' credited the no-skill baseline, which tests neither ablation.
The card was not kept. The overlap question (separate test plus external transfer, merge-partition audit absent) moves to local-6 and stays partial (opus:O02).
The card was not kept. The generality question (two domains, one transfer pair, no cross-model or cross-harness test) moves to local-7 and stays partial.
son55's unmet is revised. The reverse ablation (remove evolved skills → baseline) exists on the held-out test. What is missing is evidence that the prompt- or code-level unit is the bottleneck.
Verified: no GEPA or prompt-only comparison is reported, although prompt-only mode is implemented.
Verified: none of the five introduced components is ablated. sol's adapt RE-1 is merged here.
Failure mode absent (son55 convention: met = avoided). Benchmark gold answers and the official scorer are used, not self-constructed validation.
Verified: skill-level attribution is present. There is no defect/lapse split or edit budget.
Verified: every failure is treated as fixable by a skill edit. There is no lapse routing.
Verified: create-vs-edit at whole-skill granularity, not at the failing section.
Verified: a candidate must beat the weakest frontier member, otherwise it is discarded. There is no per-item regression check, and the validation set is 17 items.
Verified: the proposer sees traces, predictions, gold answers, the repository and the full proposal history.
Verified: the gate, history and meta-skill are separable by design but never ablated.
Verified: the contribution is the evolved unit, not the search mechanism (Feedback Descent loop reused).
Verified: OfficeQA uses a deterministic scorer. SealQA and BrowseComp use an unaudited LLM judge.
Verified: the history's value is never measured, and the frontier names no complementarity axis.
See ratings.E.measurement: the 67.9/68.1 contradiction and the non-integer BrowseComp rates. Run convention caps at 2. son55 recorded the contradiction but kept 3.

See ratings.E.causality: the store-off comparison on the held-out test isolates the retained package. The missing component and alternative-optimizer controls bound it at 2, not 1. son55's 1 penalises the untested skill-vs-prompt claim, which RE-2/RE-3 record without zeroing the package evidence.

No quantitative cost of any kind exists. A training-set fraction and epoch count do not account search or inference cost, and the 'computational cost' remark is a reason for not doing variance, not a figure.

shared_error_corrections.reason: Both seats credited the disjoint three-way split and overlooked that the reported headline is chosen on the test partition. merge-unique is a post-hoc fourth configuration announced as best because it 'outperform[s] every individual run' on test (opus:O01). Its overlap rule keeps the version from the 'highest-performing run' on an unnamed split (opus:O02). Per-config test sets differ while one baseline is quoted (opus:O03). Under EVIDENCE.md rule 2 and A2, test-set selection and partition alignment are E.holdout defects. With one-skill, one-direction transfer, anchor 2 applies.
